simple.meaning: to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בָּדַל (H914) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 42 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בָּדַל (bâdal) means to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 12 9.

definitions.short: to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.)
definitions.usage: (make, put) difference, divide (asunder), (make) separate (self, -ation), sever (out), × utterly.
definitions.full: H914. badal [ בָּדַל ] verb be divided, separate (Arabic change, substitute , Mishna בָּדַל divide , Syriac Ithpe`el, Ethpe`el) — Hiph`il divide, separate; Perfect הִבְדִּיל Num 16:9 ; Deut 10:8 ; suffix וְהִבְדִּילוֺ consecutive 29:20 ; 3 feminine singular וְהִבְדִּילָה Exod 26:33 ; וְהִבְדַּלְתָּ Num 8:14 ; הִבְדִּילוּ Ezek 22:26 , etc. Imperfect יַבְדִּיל Lev 1:17 +; וַיַּבְדֵּל Gen 1:4 , 7 ; 1Chr 25:1 ; suffix יַבְדִּילַנִי Isa 56:3 ; וָאַבְדִּל Lev 20:26 ; וָאַבְדִּילָה Ezra 8:24 , etc.; Infinitive absolute הַבְדֵּל Isa 56:3 ; construct לְהַבְדִּיל Gen 1:14 +; Participle מַבְדִּיל 1:6 ; מַבְדִּילִים Isa 59:2 ; — 1 divide, separate , subject God Gen 1:4 followed by וּבֵין .... בֵּין between light and darkness , compare 1:7 ; subject heavenly bodies 1:14 ; 1:18 ; subject firmament followed by בֵּיןלְ֗֗֗ 1:6 (all in P's source); Exod 26:33 of the מָּרֹכֶת in tabernacle, followed by לָכֶם בֵּיןוּ֗֗֗בֵין֗֗֗ ; of iniquities, separating men from God לְבֵין ֗֗֗ בֵּין Isa 59:2 . 2 separate, set apart , followed by מִן , of ׳י , setting off Israel from other peoples Lev 20:24 (H) Num 16:9 (P); Lev 20:26 followed by also לִי לִהְיוֺת ; compare 1Kin 8:53 ׳הִבְדּ לְנַחֲלָה לְךָ separate them to thyself as an inheritance ; of Moses, setting apart Levites, followed by מִתּוֺח Num 8:14 ; of separating an individual from the people, i.e. excluding him Deut 29:20 , followed by also לְרָעָה ; followed by מֵעַל Isa 56:3 (twice in verse), i.e. excluding him; compare also Neh 13:3 followed by מִן ; of setting apart (forbidding) beasts as unclean לְטַמֵּא לָכֶם Lev 20:25 ; of setting apart the tribe of Levi וגו ׳לָשֵׂאת Deut 10:8 (subject ׳י ); compare also (hum. subject) 1Chr 25:1 , followed by לַעֲבֹדָה , 2Chr 25:10 followed by Infinitive; similarly Ezra 8:24 ; even followed by participle Ezek 39:14 they shall set apart men עֹבְרִים , i.e. to pass through , or, men that shall pass through (RV); so of setting apart cities, accusative Deut 4:41 ; compare 19:2 , 7 . 3 make a distinction between clean and unclean, holy and profane, followed by בֵּיןוּ֗֗֗בֵין Lev 20:25 (H); 10:10 ; 11:47 (both P); followed by בֵּיןלְ֗֗֗ Ezek 22:26 ; 42:20 . 4 divide into parts Lev 1:17 ; 5:8 (P), prohibited in case of fowls offered in sacrifice. Niph`al Perfect נִבְדְּלוּ 1Chr 12:8 ; Ezra 9:1 ; Imperfect יִבָּדֵל 10:8 ; וַיִּבָּדֵל 1Chr 23:13 ; וַיִּבָּֽדְלוּ Ezra 10:16 ; Neh 9:2 ; Imperative הִבָּֽדְלוּ Num 16:21 ; Ezra 10:11 ; Participle נִבְדָּל 6:21 ; Neh 10:29 . 1 (reflexive of Hiph`il 2 ) a. separate oneself from people of the land, heathen, and their practices, also from non-Jewish wives, followed by מִן Ezra 6:21 ; 9:1 ; 10:11 ; Neh 9:2 ; absolute in same sense Ezra 10:16 (compare Sta G. ii. 199 & 179 n. Wl Pharisäer u. Sadd. 76 ). b. withdraw from (Moses & Aaron from Israel) Num 16:21 (P), followed by מִתּוֺח . c. separate oneself unto ( אֶל ) David 1Chr 12:8 . d. Neh 10:29 combines a. & c. separate oneself הָאֱלֹהִים אֶלתּֿוֺרַת הָֽאֲרָצוֺת מֵעַמֵּי . 2 passive, be separated . a. be excluded from the people, followed by מִן Ezra 10:8 . b. be set apart , of Aaron, followed by לְהַקְדִּישׁוֺ 1Chr 23:13 . — On הבדיל , & distinction from הפריד see Dr JPhoenician xi. 219 .
